title: Bulk Updates
subtitle: Change the same setting across many blocks in one pass. Pick a farm, choose what to update, fill it in once, then choose which blocks it lands on.

denied.title: You don't have access to bulk updates
denied.body: Assigning crops in bulk needs the crop-assignment permission at the tenant level. A farm manager can still assign crops from the Farm Console.

scope.typeTitle: What do you want to update?

crop.name: Crop assignment
crop.desc: Crop, variety, season, planting and harvest dates, spacing and crop fields.

irrigation.name: Irrigation setup
irrigation.desc: Emitter type, flow rate and scheduling defaults per block.

grid.name: Grid & zone defaults
grid.desc: Sub-block grid size and zone naming used by index sampling.

subscriptions.name: Imagery subscriptions
subscriptions.desc: Which providers and indices each block is subscribed to.

scope.noFarms: You have no farms yet. Create one from the Farm Console first.

details.effectiveFromHelp: Defaults to the planting date, else today.
details.noCropFields: This crop has no extra fields defined.

conflict.title: Blocks that already have a crop

skip.name: Only blocks without a current crop
skip.desc: Blocks already carrying an open assignment are listed but left untouched.

replace.name: Replace the current crop
replace.desc: Closes the open assignment on the effective date, then writes the new one.

conflict.historyNote: Replacing never deletes anything — the previous assignment is closed with an end date and stays on the block's crop history.

blocks.none: This farm has no active blocks to update.
blocks.searchPlaceholder: Search block name, code or current crop…
blocks.overrideHelp: Leave an override empty to use the shared value from step 2. A filled cell applies to that block only.

review.title: Preview
review.blurb: {{count}} blocks selected, {{assigned}} of them already carrying a crop. The preview shows the exact before and after for each one — nothing is written until you apply.
review.replaceWarning: {{count}} blocks will have their current crop closed and replaced.
review.noReplace: No block will lose its current crop in this run.

result.auditNote: This run is recorded in the farm's audit trail.
